svg.text: Six combinations tie on tone. Faithfulness breaks the tie.
Superseded by fig13: five seeds per cell reverse the retention column. Read this as the n=1 table it is, not as a recommendation.
Pertussis only, one row per configuration, n=1 in every cell: a ranking, not a test. Where a tier was later re-run at five seeds only its first run is here, and fig13
is where the repeats live. The grid is L-shaped, not factorial - generators varied against gemma4:31b, moderators against llama3.1:8b - so the best x best cell was
never run. Red rows invented a figure.
